batch_notes: This batch was calibrated comparatively across a wide spectrum: high-control/high-output cases (Xi, Jokowi, Trọng), mid-high cases with real crisis response (Scholz, Biden, Kishida), mixed cases with clear but imperfect delivery (Hasina, AMLO, Sisi, Prayut, Marcos, Bolsonaro, Sharif), and low cases where the main program underperformed badly or the evidence was too thin for strong credit (Putin, Erdogan, Khamenei, Buhari, Tshisekedi, Abiy).
I treated official plans, speeches, and budgets as evidence of program and operationalization only when paired with concrete appointments, financing, enforcement, implementation, or outcome records.
Discovery-only evidence was not used as decisive support.
No dossiers were unavailable, and no null score was necessary.
Scores use half-point increments and stay on one comparative meter; moral approval or disapproval of the programs was kept separate from execution scoring.
